item.title: The Gaming Stack - Console Crunch, AI Overhauls, and a Surprise Demo
item.description:

  • Xbox reportedly turned down a $500 million deal from Netflix to adapt its video game properties (Game Developer)
  • Rockstar developer union could end up over 1,600 workers strong and encompass nearly all UK staff below senior management, IWGB claim (Rock Paper Shotgun)
  • Nintendo Cancels Kirby’s Switch 2 Halloween Event After It Kept Breaking Things (Kotaku)
  • Sucker Punch lays off 24 to align with 'current market', 'next project needs' (Game Developer)

item.itunes:summary: This week the Xbox supply-chain strain hits sales, Crimson Desert offers a five-hour demo, Microsoft rolls out a voluntary exit offer amid layoffs, Epic doubles down on gen-AI tools, and Valve tackles Steam’s cloning issue. Join us for the roundup.
